name: Tape-and-Stick Note
easing: drop: spring {damping:9,stiffness:90,mass:1}; tape: EASE.back f14-24; text lines: EASE.inOut starting f24/38/48
bestFor: A takeaway / reminder / definition delivered as a pinned note.
notSuitable: Anything needing a diagram or >3 text lines.
keyframeTable: note overshoots into place near centre, tape strips start popping
note settled at -3°, both tape strips visible, first line starting to wipe
script: f0-20: the note drops from above with a spring and rotates from -15° to -3°.
f14-24: two cream tape strips pop onto the top corners.
f24-40: title is wiped in; f38-58: the two bullets wipe in one after the other.
colorRules: Cream outline, dark fill. No orange needed (add orange to ONE word only if it is the key idea).

callouts.text: text wipes in line by line
